 5                Senator Gianaris.

 6                SENATOR GIANARIS:   Mr. President, I 

 7   believe there's a privileged resolution at the 

 8   desk that would authorize the Temporary President 

 9   and Majority Leader to implement a system of 

10   remote voting during this emergency that we are 

11   currently facing.  

12                Can you please have the title only 

13   read, and I move for its immediate adoption.

14                ACTING PRESIDENT BENJAMIN:   There 

15   is a privileged resolution at the desk.  

16                The Secretary will read.

17                THE SECRETARY:  Senate Resolution 

18   3108, by Senator Stewart-Cousins, adopting 

19   special temporary procedures during a declared 

20   state of national state of emergency; and 

21   providing for the repeal of such provisions upon 

22   expiration thereof.

23                ACTING PRESIDENT BENJAMIN:   The 

24   question is on the resolution.  All those in 

25   favor signify by saying aye.

 6   resolution is adopted.
